summary: LyondellBasell filed an 8-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting on May 22, 2026. Shareholders approved 12 director nominees and the amendment and restatement of the Long Term Incentive Plan, adding 8 million shares for issuance and capping per-annum grants to non-executive directors at $2 million in grant-date fair value. This is a routine governance update with no transformative event—no M&A, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing is a standard current report of shareholder votes and compensatory plan changes, not a special situation.
